question.text: Nalanda Roll-Up Fund (Cat II AIF, trust) books FY25 'business income' of INR 6 crore. Assume business-income characterisation is upheld (old-law illustration pre Finance Act 2025 Section 2(14) amendment). What is the fund-level tax under Section 10(23FBB) (MMR 42.744% = 30% + 37% surcharge + 4% cess)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Business income of a trust-structured AIF is taxed at the fund level at MMR (Section 10(23FBB)). MMR = basic 30% + surcharge 37% + cess 4% = 42.744%. 6 cr x 42.744% = INR 2,56,46,400. The income is then exempt in unit-holders' hands. The Trap: Option A is LTCG rate — wrong for business income. Option B is the Cat I/II pass-through for non-business income. Option D is the 115QA buyback tax rate. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A and XIX-B test MMR at concept; XIX-C expects precise numerical computation. Manager's Pro-Tip: Before FY25 closure, reclassify any 'marginal' business income as capital gains where defensible (intent, holding period, accounting treatment). Post FA 2025, Section 2(14) has been amended to treat securities held by Cat I/II AIFs as capital assets — but this applies from FY 2025-26; FY25 requires the old framework.
